chunks: A man asked the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, and said:
Why is it that we find in ourselves toward our children what they do not find toward us?
He said: Because they are from you, but you are not from them.

key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.بِأَوْلَادِنَا: toward our children; concerning our children
key_terms.رَجُلٌ: a man who asks the question

ai.seo_question: Why do parents feel more attached to their children than children feel to their parents?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the natural strength of parental attachment toward children. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teaches that this bond is rooted in the child's origin from the parent, highlighting a deep human reality within family relations.
